semantic.justification: Native HTML import foundation for Markdown raw HTML: pinned token/option/entity/color tables, mutable option scanners, text/entity/quote/whitespace automaton, raw script/style/comment scanner, paired-token/tag/EOF scanner, PRE/listing/XMP filters, and shared SvParser incremental character conversion, ring replay and saved state. Uses existing SAL converter functions and the native descriptor/context public API; no browser DOM grammar. Source-only tests currently pass; compiled upstream lexer differential and Writer HTMLReader integration remain pending. The memory stream has no asynchronous device, redline/layout or native allocation lifetime. Its BOM-only probe covers the internal UTF-8 HTML data supplied by Markdown; a general external HTML/ICU encoding detector is not claimed. S3HW1E HTML35: complete original HTMLTableOptions default fields, reverse option iteration, uint16-before-percent conversion, final zero/unset-border suppression, explicit frame/rules precedence, color priority and raw option strings are implemented against actual HTMLOption/HTMLParser owners. Original public table enums and HTMLOption bool/output GetEnum plus GetTableFrame/GetTableRules reuse module-owned native alias tables. The connected Writer ALIGN helper now consumes original aHTMLPAlignTable, replacing its reduced switch and preserving native middle/char aliases and ASCII-only matching. Actual lexer/option and Markdown paragraph tests provide bounded evidence. This is a concrete table-reader prerequisite; HTML table construction/context/geometry/node insertion is not yet connected or claimed complete, and broader native API/module/ABI status is unchanged. File UI/autosave/recovery deviations remain preserved.
